inputs.label: GameCube or Wii games
inputs.help: Your own dumped GameCube or Wii games.

steps.text: Open DolphinXR from Library > Unknown Sources. Apply the recommended Quest bindings on the first-launch screen, then add the Download folder to the game library and start a game.

notes: Uncertain: the guide names no file types; the extension list is Dolphin's usual set. The guide lets the user pick any folder; Download is a choice. The guide still names the v0.4 APK (Dolphin-VR-Redux-app-quest-debug.apk); v0.5 renamed it to DolphinVR-Redux-v0.5-Quest.apk, so the asset pattern only matches v0.5 and later naming. The optional GameSettingsVR profiles are not modelled.
